thread:
alex: heads-up — console telemetry: saved views scoped to a route sometimes show 0 per-route tokens after sampling kicks in. noticed on a high-traffic /api/generate route this morning, looks like totals are fine but per-model/per-route breakdown disappears.

mira: thanks — can you paste repro steps + the savedview payload you used?

alex: steps: 1) open route view -> set model filter to gpt-small 2) save view with sampleRate=0.01 3) wait 10m -> per-model column shows dashes. here's the savedview body we POSTed:

```json
{"name":"gpt-small route filter","scope":"route","route":"/api/generate","filters":{"model":"gpt-small"},"sampling":0.01}
```

jordan: hm — sounds like we apply sampling at ingestion and then our console aggregates try to scale but lose low-cardinality keys when sampleRate < threshold. we currently only backfill route/model keys when count_estimate >= 100 before shard-merge.

samir: api contract question: do saved views carry an explicit sampling hint today? we have sampling on telemetry-side but savedview metadata doesn't persist the effective sampleRate in older saves. migrating that feels risky.

katy: product POV — users expect "saved query == deterministic view". if telemetry is partial we should show a clear banner and not silently hide per-model breakdowns. ideally show an explanation and a link to docs. :warning:

telemetry-bot: alert: telemetry_ingest_low_cardinality detected for route=/api/generate, sampleRate=0.01, window=15m

mira: proposal: quick mitigation = show "partial telemetry" banner for savedviews where sampling < 1 OR where savedview.metadata has samplingKey missing. Also persist a new field `metadata.telemetryPartial:true/false` for UX decisions. Then separately, enhance ingestion to emit a per-savedview key fallback at aggregator when count_estimate below threshold.

alex: +1 for banner. worried about migration: existing savedviews need to get metadata populated. do we default to telemetryPartial=true for legacy saves? that might spam the banner.

jordan: rollout plan idea: 1) API: add optional field `metadata.effectiveSample` to savedviews (no required migration) 2) Console: show banner only if effectiveSample < 1 OR if there's a recent ingest alert for that route 3) Backfill job (async) to compute effectiveSample for legacy views over 14 days and update gradually behind feature-flag. canary at 10% orgs.

samir: API snippet for the new patch we discussed:

```http
PATCH /api/savedviews/:id
Content-Type: application/json
{ "metadata": { "effectiveSample": 0.01 } }
```

mira: implementation notes: console needs to check three places: savedview.metadata.effectiveSample, route telemetry health API, and recent sampling alerts. UI should avoid spamming banners every open — cache state per-view for 5 minutes.

viv: devex will prepare copy: short banner text + help center doc. also will add a note for migration: "If your saved view shows partial telemetry it means sampled traces may omit low-volume models/keys." I'll add sample screenshots for the canary.

katy: ok action items: - miro (mira): implement banner + 5m cache - jordan: API + backfill job plan + canary rollout - samir: update openapi contract + tests - viv: docs + banner copy - alex: monitor /api/generate and share logs if this pops again.

alex: thanks — i'll watch and send logs if it recurs. :thumbsup:
